spec.description: JVM runtime overview for stable OpenTelemetry Java auto-instrumentation metrics stored with Prometheus-compatible metric and label names.

spec.title: JVM instances
spec.description: Distinct JVM targets reporting OpenTelemetry runtime memory metrics.

spec.title: Average JVM CPU
spec.description: Average recent JVM process CPU utilization across the selected targets.

spec.title: Heap used
spec.description: Total heap memory currently used across the selected targets.

spec.title: Heap limit
spec.description: Total finite heap limit across the selected targets.

spec.title: Heap utilization
spec.description: Current heap usage divided by the finite heap limit.

spec.title: GC pause p95
spec.description: 95th percentile garbage-collection pause over the last five minutes.

spec.title: Live threads
spec.description: Current platform-thread count across the selected JVMs.

spec.title: Loaded classes
spec.description: Current loaded-class count across the selected JVMs.

spec.title: JVM CPU utilization
spec.description: Recent JVM process CPU utilization by service and JVM target.

spec.title: Heap utilization by JVM
spec.description: Heap usage as a percentage of the finite heap limit for each JVM target.

spec.expr: 100 * sum by (service_name, service_instance_id, instance) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_namespace=~"${service_namespace:regex}",service_name=~"${service_name:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${service_instance_id:regex}",jvm_memory_type="heap"}) / clamp_min(sum by (service_name, service_instance_id, instance) (jvm_memory_limit_bytes{service_namespace=~"${service_namespace:regex}",service_name=~"${service_name:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${service_instance_id:regex}",jvm_memory_type="heap"} > 0), 1)

spec.title: Heap memory
spec.description: Used, committed, and finite maximum heap memory across selected JVMs.

spec.title: Memory pools
spec.description: Current and post-GC memory usage by pool, memory type, service, and JVM target.

spec.expr: sum by (service_name, service_instance_id, instance, jvm_memory_type, jvm_memory_pool_name) (jvm_memory_used_bytes{service_namespace=~"${service_namespace:regex}",service_name=~"${service_name:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${service_instance_id:regex}"})

sum by (service_name, service_instance_id, instance, jvm_memory_type, jvm_memory_pool_name) (jvm_memory_used_after_last_gc_bytes{service_namespace=~"${service_namespace:regex}",service_name=~"${service_name:regex}",service_instance_id=~"${service_instance_id:regex}"})

spec.title: GC pause quantiles
spec.description: Garbage-collection pause latency calculated from the OpenTelemetry duration histogram.

spec.title: GC events
spec.description: Garbage-collection event rate by collector name and action.

spec.title: Threads by state
spec.description: Current platform-thread count split by state and daemon flag.

spec.title: Class load and unload rate
spec.description: Per-second class loading and unloading activity across selected JVMs.

spec.title: OpenTelemetry JVM Overview v3
